title: Q-Guided Stein Variational Model Predictive Control via RL-informed Policy Prior
abstract: arXiv:2507.06625v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model Predictive Control (MPC) enables reliable trajectory optimization under dynamics constraints, but often depends on accurate dynamics models and carefully hand-designed cost functions. Recent learning-based MPC methods aim to reduce these modeling and cost-design burdens by learning dynamics, priors, or value-related guidance signals. Yet many existing approaches still rely on deterministic gradient-based solvers (e.g., differentiable MPC) or parametric sampling-based updates (e.g., CEM/MPPI), which can lead to mode collapse and convergence to a single dominant solution. We propose Q-SVMPC, a Q-guided Stein variational MPC method with an RL-informed policy prior, which casts learning-based MPC as trajectory-level posterior inference and refines trajectory particles via SVGD under learned soft Q-value guidance to explicitly preserve diverse solutions. translated_title: 基于强化学习信息策略先验的Q引导Stein变分模型预测控制
translated_abstract: 模型预测控制（MPC）能够在动力学约束下实现可靠的轨迹优化，但通常依赖于精确的动力学模型和精心手工设计的代价函数。近年来基于学习的MPC方法旨在通过学习动力学、先验或与价值相关的引导信号来减轻这些建模与代价设计的负担。然而，许多现有方法仍依赖于确定性的基于梯度的求解器（如可微分MPC）或参数化的基于采样的更新（如CEM/MPPI），这可能导致模式坍缩并收敛到单一的主导解。我们提出Q-SVMPC，一种具有强化学习信息策略先验的Q引导Stein变分MPC方法，该方法将基于学习的MPC转化为轨迹级后验推断，并在学习到的软Q值引导下通过SVGD对轨迹粒子进行细化，以显式地保留多样化的解。在导航、机器人操作以及真实世界水果采摘（实验）……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Q-SVMPC方法，将基于学习的模型预测控制转化为轨迹级后验推断，通过强化学习软Q值引导和策略先验下的Stein变分梯度下降保留多样化轨迹解，从而避免传统方法的模式坍缩问题。
